sources: https://www.greatriverroad-illinois.org/Great-River-Road-Campground (Great Rivers Country / Illinois Great River Road byway site, IDOT-grant funded regional tourism listing; read live with the headless browser, desktop Chrome UA, 2026-11-20): 'GREAT RIVER ROAD CAMPGROUND - Commerce Street and Fairground Road, Pleasant Hill IL 62366 | 217.734.2113 - Small campsite located next to the Pike County Fairgrounds. Sites offer a variety of hookups, are located close together, and do not offer shade.' Wayback shows the same short page since 2020.

https://pikecountyfairillinois.com/ and its Contact, Fair Board and Lodging pages (Pike County Fair, Pleasant Hill; read 2026-11-20): no mention of a campground, RV camping or this phone number; the fair's lodging list does not name it.

Google Maps via headless browser (2026-11-20): no place for 'Great River Road Campground' in Pleasant Hill (queries returned Pere Marquette and an Iowa campground); 'Pike County Fair', 210 W Clay St, Pleasant Hill, 4.1 over 69, website pikecountyfairillinois.com, at 39.4396,-90.8783.

Web searches 2026-11-20: '217-734-2113' appears on no official page; only aggregators (Campendium, Allstays, Good Sam, RV Life, ParkAdvisor, The Dyrt) list the campground - Campendium's point 39.426,-90.867 is a crop field.

Esri World_Imagery (39.4388,-90.8778 at 230 m half-width, and z19 tiles at 39.4387,-90.8780, read 2026-11-20): the pin sits in mowed grass inside the fairgrounds between show barns, a lane and the rail line; no pads, pull-throughs or pedestal rows are visible - nothing resembling a 59-site full-hookup campground.

sites.source: https://www.greatriverroad-illinois.org/Great-River-Road-Campground (read 2026-11-20): 'Small campsite ... Sites ... are located close together'. The stored 59 sites / 40 pull-throughs / 60-ft max came only from aggregators (allstays/Good Sam/RV Life per inclusion_evidence), contradict the 'small campsite' wording and are not seen on imagery - cleared.

season.source: No official page states a season; the stored 'Approximate: Open April to October' came from directory listings only - cleared.

note: Small campground beside the Pike County Fairgrounds in Pleasant Hill; sites sit close together with no shade. --Claude
summary: Byway tourism page now readable via headless browser: 'Small campsite next to the Pike County Fairgrounds', variety of hookups, close together, no shade. No operator page, no Google Maps place, fair website silent, imagery shows only fairground grass. Cleared aggregator-only sites (59/60 ft/pull-through) and season. Inclusion doubtful - drop candidate.
flags: CRITERIA / PRESENCE (drop candidate): no operator is identified anywhere official - the only non-aggregator page is the byway tourism listing ('Small campsite located next to the Pike County Fairgrounds'); the Pike County Fair's own site does not mention camping; Google Maps has no place for it; the phone 217-734-2113 appears on no official page. As a fairgrounds campground it is NOT shown to rent ordinary nights outside the fair (no rate, no season, no booking method from any official source). Imagery at the pin shows only mowed fairground grass, not 59 full-hookup sites.

CLEARED: sites.count 59, max_rig_ft 60, pull_through, and the 'Approximate April-October' season - all aggregator-derived and contradicted by the byway page's 'small campsite'. Hookups (50 A/water/sewer) and booking 'phone' are also aggregator/note-derived and unconfirmed (the byway page says only 'a variety of hookups'); left for the reviewer.
OWNERSHIP: 'local' is unproven - no county, village or fair-board page claims it; the Pike County Fair board (a fair association) would make it local by DB convention only if it runs it.
WEBSITE: https://www.greatriverroad-illinois.org/Great-River-Road-Campground is a regional tourism listing, not an operator page; no operator page exists to replace it.
PIN: 39.43802,-90.87732 is inside the fairgrounds (fair's Google point 39.4396,-90.8783, ~200 m N); no campground to centre on.
